title: Add button
description: A button that opens a form and adds one record to a list another widget draws.

create.label: Add the record
create.hint: Bind it to @core/rows-create aimed at the list, and switch it on.

getLabel.label: Label
getLabel.hint: Empty draws a plus alone; write a label when what is added is not obvious from where it stands.

getTitle.label: Form title
getTitle.hint: Heads the form, and names the plus for a screen reader.

getFields.label: Fields
getFields.hint: One row per field the form asks for: name, label, kind (line, text, number, choice, lines), options, isRequired.

getPreset.label: Preset
getPreset.hint: Values every new record starts with. $today becomes today's date.

getNameFrom.label: Note name from
getNameFrom.hint: The field whose value names the new note.
